scope: Three candidate research files plus v2 gate metadata/disk deltas only; external audit v2 and final deployment bundle require separate review.
verified_behaviors: Canonicalization accepts only complete bare or GPU-prefixed grouped hexadecimal UUIDs; it does not guess ordinals, prefixes, MIG mappings, lists or whitespace.
CUDA raw UUID and canonical UUID are both retained. nvidia-smi queries the canonical identifier and mismatched readback is refused.
EnergyCounter binds the canonical CUDA identifier to a same-device NVML UUID readback before creating a physical counter. Mapping verification alone never makes unsupported energy readings available.

Matrix energy completeness requires the exact canonical counter, finite nonnegative reading, completed interval, mapping_verified true, and both raw/canonical device mappings. Malformed identity/readings return false.
Original probe UUID is normalized externally for identity comparison without editing the raw receipt, original probe, baseline, configuration, or numerical implementation.

TMPDIR and the five declared compute/cache directories are task-local on the data volume; data reserve remains 5 GiB and the separate control filesystem guard is 1 GiB. Only free byte counts are recorded for the control filesystem.
Candidate source-map/aggregate hash and strict count were updated consistently; model definitions, training draws, seeds, splits, budgets and rematerialization implementation did not change.
concrete_review_issue_closed: Truthy malformed identity objects originally raised AttributeError in physical-energy summary; dict guards and a truthy string/list control now return unavailable energy while retaining training counts.
limitations: No Torch imported and no CUDA/model computation performed by this independent review.
